item.title: Open PDF Editor 0.4.0
item.description: Forms. Click a form field to fill it in: type into text fields in place (Tab moves to the next one), tick checkboxes and radio buttons, and choose from dropdowns and lists. View › Highlight Form Fields tints the fields you can fill in. Forms › Edit Fields lets you add text fields, checkboxes, radio buttons, dropdowns, list boxes and signature fields, move and resize them, and set their name, tooltip, choices and options in the inspector. Forms › Flatten Form makes what you filled in part of the pages. Every change can be undone. Scripts in forms never run. The new Settings window (⌘,) has switches for opening web and email links and for converting documents other than PDFs and images; both are off until you turn them on, and pointing at a link shows where it goes. The app no longer checks for updates by itself: use Check for Updates… when you want to.
